title: Arcane Index Reference: Important Systems
summary: Understand categories, relations, providers, and generated bridge records.

blocks.title: Categories
blocks.body: Arcane Index groups overview, Aether Signal, relics, spells, rituals, curses, machines, rifts, familiars, mobs, landmarks, boss gates, and forbidden knowledge.

blocks.title: Relations
blocks.body: Relations are the useful trail. Follow them from item to recipe, ritual to archive, curse to cleansing route, or landmark to route context.

blocks.title: Providers
blocks.body: Providers can generate pages from Arcana Core services or bridge catalogs. If a provider is quiet, the page set will be quiet too.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
